events.title: Project Q – Grand Finale (24-hour Hackathon)
events.description:
The finale of the Project Q hackathon: 24 hours of continuous, on-campus building for the confirmed (shortlisted) teams.
Teams build, refine and present their final solution live to the judging panel. Prize pool ₹1,00,000 plus certificates.
Starts Wed 28 Oct, 6:00 PM · ends Thu 29 Oct, 6:00 PM.
events.speaker: SRM University AP × IBM Quantum Qiskit Fall Fest

events.title: Project Q – Winner Announcement
events.description: Final results, top teams and winners of Project Q. Cash prizes, certificates and special awards, based on jury evaluation.

faqs.a: Online phase: 8–10 October 2026. Offline phase: 26–30 October 2026 at SRM University AP, Amaravati.

faqs.q: How do I get into the offline phase?
faqs.a: Only a limited number of selected participants are invited. Selection follows each programme's eligibility and selection criteria; shortlisted teams are informed directly.
